name: mstack-diagnose
description: Diagnose crashes, bugs, regressions, flaky failures, performance problems, hangs and leaks with evidence: intake, a signal from a live loop or a saved crash record, ranked falsifiable hypotheses, one-variable probes, a regression test before the fix, graded root-cause tiers and fix verdicts. One skill for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Find and prove the cause of a crash, bug, regression or slowdown.
interface.longDescription: An evidence-first diagnosis method. It records the exact symptom, gets a signal from a failing loop or a saved crash record, ranks falsifiable hypotheses, proves one with single-variable probes, and fixes only with a regression test that fails first. Branches cover Linux, macOS and Windows crashes, language runtimes, git bisect regressions, flaky tests, performance, hangs and leaks. Every root cause gets a confidence tier and every fix a verdict.
